nodes.name: boost_9v
nodes.description: MT3608 boost converter steps USB_5V up to VCC_9V for NE5532 preamplifier. FB pin requires external feedback divider for 9V regulation (passive network). EN pin tied high to always enable. SW pin switching output requires inductor and bypass caps.

nodes.name: SW
nodes.description: Power switch output, drain of internal MOSFET, connects to inductor and output rectifier, swings between GND and 28V

nodes.name: GND
nodes.description: Ground pin, connect to strong ground plane for heat sinking

nodes.name: FB
nodes.description: Feedback input, 0.6V reference voltage, connect resistor divider for output voltage setting

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Regulator enable input, active high (VIH>=1.5V, VIL<=0.4V), connect to VIN for automatic startup

nodes.name: VIN
nodes.description: Input supply pin, operating range 2V-24V, must be locally bypassed with capacitor

nodes.name: NC
nodes.description: No connect, leave floating, do not connect to any net

nodes.name: ldo_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps USB_5V down to VCC_3V3 for MCU and DAC. No enable pin; Vin-Vout bypass caps required.

nodes.name: mcu_atmega328p
nodes.description: ATmega328P MCU operates on VCC_3V3, uses AVCC for analog section (must be connected). AREF pin tied to GND or VCC_3V3 per design intent (no external reference). No crystal listed; assume internal oscillator used. I2C pins (SDA: PD1, SCL: PD0) drive MCP4725. No pull-ups listed; MCU module owns shared I2C bus biasing policy.

nodes.name: dac_mcp4725
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC operates on VCC_3V3. A0 pin tied to GND (or other address) via passive. SDA, SCL connect to MCU I2C. VOUT provides GAIN_CTRL analog output to NE5532 preamp.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamp_ne5532
nodes.description: NE5532 dual op-amp preamplifier operates on split supply VCC_9V and GND. VCC_P=+9V, VCC_N=GND. Inputs (IN1_P, IN2_P) receive external audio signals (not detailed in brief). GAIN_CTRL DAC output feeds bias/gain-control network (passive) for both channels. Outputs OUT1, OUT2 drive PAM8403 inputs.

nodes.name: amp_pam8403
nodes.description: PAM8403 Class-D stereo amplifier operates on USB_5V directly. MUTE and SHDN pins require control logic (tied high for enabled). VREF internal reference needs capacitor to GND. PVDD_1 and PVDD_2 for power stage bypass. Inputs INL, INR receive preamp outputs; outputs drive speakers.

nodes.name: VREF
nodes.description: Internal Analog Reference, requires bypass capacitor to GND

nodes.name: SHDN
